reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: At least 10 characters. Every other device gets signed out.
reset.goneLead: It was used already or is older than 30 minutes. Ask for a new one, it only takes a moment.
reset.failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

strength.label: Password strength
strength.weak: Weak. Add a few more words or characters.

issues.title: Errors
issues.sub: What went wrong in production. Open ones first, newest first.
issues.loadFailed: The errors could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
issues.emptyBody: Nothing new has gone wrong. New errors show up here, and you get an email about each new one.
issues.gone: This error is no longer kept. Errors are kept for 30 days.
issues.resolvedNote: Resolved. It opens again by itself if it happens again.
issues.ignoredNote: Ignored. It is still counted, but it stays out of the open list and sends no email.
issues.actionsFoot: Resolve it once it is fixed. Ignore what is expected and harmless.

detail.noStack: There is no stack for this one.

boundary.title: This screen did not load
boundary.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, the details are already with us.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.foot: Customers see the name in their language when there is one.
categories.taken: There is already a category with this name.
categories.deleteBody: Its products stay, they just have no category until you choose one.
categories.emptyBody: Group products like Oils, Honey or Gifts, so they are easy to find in the shop page and in Stock.
categories.listFoot: Tap a category to rename it.
categories.pictureFoot: An icon or a photo, shown on your shop page and in Stock.

label.title: Shelf label
label.lead: Cut along the dashed lines. The QR code opens the product's page, where customers can ask to hear when it is back.
label.noCode: Add a barcode or make a shop code first, the label needs one.
label.noPrice: The price is left off because customers do not see prices. Settings, What customers see.

emailRevert.title: Put your old email back?
emailRevert.lead: The email on your Custock account was changed. If it was not you, undo it here. Every device is signed out and your old email works again.
emailRevert.doneBody: Your account uses {{email}} again. Sign in once more on your devices.
emailRevert.forgot: If someone also changed your password, ask for a new one.
emailRevert.failTitle: This link does not work any more
emailRevert.failBody: It was used already, it is older than 7 days, or the email was changed again since.

post.title: This post is no longer here

product.title: This product is no longer here

transfer.title: This transfer is no longer here

count.title: This count is no longer here

shopProduct.title: This product is no longer available

gone.shopPost: This post is no longer available.

draft.restored: Picked up where you left off.

order.full: An order holds up to {{count}} products.

rejected.any: You said no to the price

declined.any: The shop could not take the order

rejected.any: The customer said no to the price

orders.offBody: Ask in the shop, they will gladly help.
orders.emptyBody: Add products from the shop with Add to order.

error.prices_changed: A price changed in the meantime. Check the total and send again.
error.limit_reached: You already have as many open orders as this shop takes. Wait for one to finish.
error.orders_off: This shop does not take orders right now.
error.quote_expired: This price no longer holds. You can order again.
error.forbidden: Join the shop first to send orders.

problem.unavailable: No longer available, remove it to send

orders.askFoot: {{org}} looks at your order and sends you a price. You say yes or no.
orders.pricedFoot: Prices with VAT. The shop confirms your order.
orders.payFoot: You pay when you pick up. Nothing is charged now.
orders.notePlaceholder: For example: sliced, or deliver to …
orders.fixLines: Remove the products that can not be ordered, then send.
orders.sendFoot: The shop confirms it and tells you when it is ready.
orders.askSendFoot: Nothing to pay now. You decide when you see the price.
orders.noneBody: Orders you send to the shop show up here.
orders.goneBody: It may belong to another account.
orders.goneStaffBody: It may be at a shop you do not see.
orders.acceptedToast: Accepted. The shop prepares your order.

state.requested: The shop is looking at your order and will send you a price.
state.requestedPriced: Sent. The shop will confirm your order.
state.confirmed: Confirmed. You hear from us when it is ready.
state.declined: The shop could not take this order.
state.rejected: You said no to the price.
state.expired: The price ran out. You can order again.

orders.cancelBody: The shop is told. This can not be undone.
orders.emptyStaffBody: When a customer orders from the shop's app, it shows up here and you get a notification.
orders.askStaffFoot: Send a price for every product. The customer says yes or no.
orders.pickedFoot: Picked up takes the products off the stock as sales.
orders.readyToast: Marked ready. The customer is told.
orders.vatFoot: Prices with VAT, like on the shelf.
orders.messagePlaceholder: For example: for 20 we can do 9 € each.
orders.quoteFoot: The customer gets it by notification and email and says yes or no.
orders.declineBody: Tell the customer why. They read it in their notification and email.
orders.cancelStaffBody: Tell the customer why. They read it in their notification and email.
orders.reasonPlaceholder: For example: we are out of it until next week.
orders.holdsFoot: Confirmed and ready orders. The stock goes down when they are picked up.
